an8.7:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was staying near Rājagaha on Vulture Peak Mountain, not long after Devadatta’s departure.
an8.7:1.2: There, referring to Devadatta, he addressed the monks:
an8.7:1.3: “Monks, it’s good for a monk periodically to have reflected on his own failings.
an8.7:1.4: It’s good for a monk periodically to have reflected on the failings of others.
an8.7:1.5: It’s good for a monk periodically to have reflected on his own attainments.
an8.7:1.6: It’s good for a monk periodically to have reflected on the attainments of others.
an8.7:1.7: “Conquered by eight untrue dhammas, his mind overcome, Devadatta is headed for a state of deprivation, headed for hell, there to stay for an eon, incurable.
an8.7:2.2: “Conquered by material gain, his mind overcome, Devadatta is headed for a state of deprivation, headed for hell, there to stay for an eon, incurable.
an8.7:2.9: “Conquered by evil friendship, his mind overcome, Devadatta is headed for a state of deprivation, headed for hell, there to stay for an eon, incurable.
an8.7:3.1: “Monks, it’s good for a monk to keep conquering again & again any arisen material gain.
an8.7:3.2: It’s good for a monk to keep conquering again & again any arisen lack of material gain…
an8.7:4.1: “And for what compelling reason should a monk keep conquering again & again any arisen material gain…
an8.7:5.1: Because when one dwells not having conquered any arisen material gain, effluents arise, along with vexations & fevers. But when one dwells having conquered any arisen material gain, those effluents, vexations, & fevers are not.
an8.7:5.2: [Similarly with any arisen lack of material gain, any arisen status, any arisen lack of status, any arisen offerings, any arisen lack of offerings, any arisen evil ambition, & any arisen evil friendship.]
an8.7:5.9: “It’s for this compelling reason that a monk should keep conquering again & again any arisen material gain…
an8.7:6.2: ‘We will keep conquering again & again any arisen material gain…
an8.7:6.3: any arisen lack of material gain…
an8.7:6.10: That’s how you should train yourselves.”
